t: Din tzerup lezimmun shelosha o asara
s: Din tzerup lezimmun shelosha o asara, ubo t' seipim: shenayim sheakelu keachat vegameru seudatam uba shelishi veqaba etzlam, im enam sebeim kol kak beinyan sheim hayu mebiim lipnehem ezeh dabar hechabib etzlam leqinnuach seuda hayu yekolim leekol mimmenna apillu kol shehu — lo nigmera seudatam adayin umitztarep immahem, ap al pi shello akelu kelum mishshebba etzlam. Veim ameru kebar "nebarek birkat hammazon" — hare hissichu datam milleekol od, venigmera seudatam, veshub eno mitztarep immahem, ella im ken akelu immo. (Veen tzarik lomar im hissichu datam beperush milleekol od. Veap lehaomerim shehessach haddaat meakila eno zaquq lachazor lebarek "hammotzi" im nimlak lachazor veleekol, mippene sheddarko shel adam lihyot nimlak bisudato lehimmashek misseuda qetanna ligdola, mikkol maqom kol zeman sheeno nimlak vechozer veokel — nigmera akila harishona behessach dato, kevan sheomed bedato veeno chozer mimmenna [)]. Umikkol maqom, apillu natelu yedehem mayim acharonim — mitzva sheyyachzeru veyittelu mayim rishonim vibareku "hammotzi" veyoklu kezayit kede lebarek bezimmun. Vaapillu im zeh eno chapetz leekol kelal — mitzva sheyyittenu lo leekol meat kede lezammen alayv, shekkol shenayim sheakelu keechad mitzva alehem lechazzer achar zimmun kol mah sheyyekolim, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g:

En mezammenin ella al mi sheakal kezayit, sheppachot mikkezayit eno niqra akila, vaapillu akal pat. Umishsheakal kezayit mezammenin alayv, umitztarep ben lishlosha ben laasara, apillu akal kezayit yaraq o shear perot. Vaapillu en kezayit bayyaraq, ella shettibbelo betzir veakal veyesh bo kezayit im hatztzir sheal gabbe hazzayit — mezammenin alayv, shehatztzir mitztarep, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"y. Vaapillu lo akal kelum ella shata rebiit meezeh mashqeh, vaapillu min hammayim — mitztarep immahem veoneh: "baruk sheakalnu", sheshshetiyya biklal akila. Vehu sheakal kezayit zeh o shata rebiit zo leachar sheala veheseb immahem al hammitta bime chakme hattalmud, shekkak hayeta derek qebiut seudatam, ubazzeman hazzeh bishiba beshulchan echad, sheim lo ken ap mi sheokel pat eno mitztarep, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik lesheb ella bishat akilato o shetiyyato, abal bishat hazzimmun yekolim lezammen alayv apillu omed bachutz lipne happetach, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"d. Vaapillu shelosha sheakelu yaraq o shatu mitztorpim leshiba sheakelu pat lezammen beshem, hoil verob hannikkar hu meokele pat. Abal shishsha sheakelu pat — en mezammenin beshem betzerup arbaa shello akelu pat, sheshshishsha enam rob hannikkar. Veyesh omerim shello heqellu baakilat yaraq o shear okalim chutz min happat ubishtiyyat kol mashqeh, ella lehitztarep laasara, shekkebar yesh meokele happat shiur harauy lezimmun, ella sheenan rashshain lehazkir hashshem bepachot measara, laken day betzerup shelosha okele yaraq, o shotim ezeh mashqeh, shehem yekolim gam ken laanot immahem: "baruk elohenu sheakalnu mishshello", abal bezimmun shelosha, kol sheen shelosha sheakelu pat shehem chayyabim bezimmun — en mezammenin betzerup mi shello akal pat, kevan sheeno chayyab bezimmun. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, sheim akelu shenayim uba shelishi etzlam vikolim lehazqiqo sheyyokal kezayit pat — yittenu lo pat. Abal im eno rotzeh — nohagin litten lo lishtot, o leekol mine megadim, umezammenim alayv, kassebara harishona:

Vekol zeh leinyan tzerup, abal shelosha okele pat shemmezammenim ledibre hakkol — yakol laanot immahem ap mi sheakal kezayit yaraq o shata rebiit, vaapillu shello bishiba bashshulchan immahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"ch:

Hammitztarep tzarik lizzaher shello lebarek beraka acharona ad sheyyezammenu alayv, sheim berak beraka acharona al akilato o shetiyyato — shub eno yakol lezammen velaanot immahem, shekkebar nistalleq mehem:

Ad hekan hu hazzimmun? Ad siyyum birkat "hazzan", shekkol hammitztorpim lazzimmun tzerikim lekavven velishmoa beraka rishona mibbirkat hammazon mippi hamzammen, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g. Veap al pi sheshshama birkat "hazzan", lo niptar bah mibberaka acharona al akilato, ella im ken akal temarim, ubishtiyya lo niptar ella im ken shata yayin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yekavven shello latzet yede chobato lekattechilla bishmiato birkat hammazon, shellekattechilla tzarik lebarek al kol min beraka hareuya lo, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Shenayim sheakelu vesabeu venatenu lishlishi leekol meat sheyyitztarep immahem lezimmun, im akal kezayit pat — yakol lebarek lahem birkat hammazon, apillu lo akal kede sebia veeno chayyab bebirkat hammazon min hattora kemotam, lepi shemmin hattora ap mi shello akal kelal yakol lehotzi et mi sheakal vesaba, shello ameru: kol mi sheeno mechuyyab baddabar eno motzi acherim yede chobatam, ella bemi sheeno metzuvveh kelal, kemo nashim bemitzvot sheenan nohagot bahen, abal kol shemmitzva zo noheget bahen, ap al pi shello nitchayyeb bah atta hu ella chabero — niqra hu gam ken mechuyyab baddabar middin arebut, shekkol yisrael arebim zeh bazeh, vealayv lehatztzil chabero meavon, ulepotro mimmitzva shennitchayyeb bah. Veap shebbirkat hammazon hi birkat hannehenin, ubebirkat hannehenin mi sheeno nehena eno motzi et mi shennehena, lepi sheeno mechuyyab bibraka zo mishshum arebut hoil veeno choba al chabero, sheyyakol hu shello lehanot veshello lehitchayyeb bibraka, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z, mikkol maqom, bebirkat hammazon kevan shekkebar nehena venitchayyeb lebarek — mechuyyab hu lehatztzilo meavon ulebarek lo. Ella shehachakamim ameru, shemmi shello akal pat eno yakol lebarek birkat hammazon, sheen lebarek birkat hannehenin belo hanaa, vesameku zeh al mah shekkatub: "veakalta vesabota uberakta", mi sheakal hu yebarek. Vaapillu im zeh sheakal vesaba eno yodea lebarek — en chabero mebarek lo, sheyyesh koach beyad chakamim laaqor dabar min hattora besheb veal taaseh, veod shezzeh enah aqira, sheyyakol acher leekol immo ulebarek lo. Abal mi sheakal pat apillu kezayit, kevan shemmebarek al hanaat atzmo — motzi gam ken chabero sheakal kede sebia. Abal im lo akal kezayit pat shemmebarekin acharayv birkat hammazon, apillu akal tabshil mechameshet hamminim shemmebarekin acharayv meen shalosh — eno yakol lebarek birkat hammazon kede lehotzi et haokelim pat, apillu lo akelu ella kezayit. Veyesh omerim shemmi shello akal kede sebia eno motzi et mi sheakal kede sebia. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, sheim bene chabura miqtzatam akelu kede sebia umiqtzatam lo akelu kede sebia — mebarek echad mehaokelim kede sebia veyotzeim haacherim. Ella im ken shehaokelim kede sebia en bahem mi sheyyodea lebarek — azay yebarek mi sheakal kezayit veyotzi et kullam yede chobatam (im haya sabea kebar qodem sheakal hakkezayit, shei epshar lo lehabi atzmo lide chiyyub shel tora al yede sheyyokal yoter. Abal im epshar lo leekol yoter — yesh lachosh lassebara haacharona):

Veim akelu kullam kede sebia, umiqtzatam shatu umiqtzatam lo shatu vehem teebim lishtot — tob sheyyebarek mi sheshshata, lepi sheyyesh omerim shemmin hattora eno chayyab lebarek ella im shata im hu taeb lishtot, shenneemar "veakalta vesabota", vedareshu chakamim: "veakalta" — zo akila, "vesabota" — zo shetiyya. Veap al pi sheen dibrehem iqqar, shezzeh semek bealma hu shessameku chakamim lechayyeb birkat hammazon al kezayit, shenneemar "veakalta" — zo akila, vaakila bikzayit, "vesabota" — zo shetiyya, abal en hammiqra yotze mide peshuto, sheeno chayyab lebarek ella kesheakal vesaba vaapillu lo shata, mikkol maqom tob lachosh ledibrehem bemaqom sheepshar, sheyyebarek mi sheshshata. Abal im miqtzatam akelu lasoba velo shatu umiqtzatam lo akelu lasoba veshatu — yebarek mi sheakal lasoba ap al pi shello shata, kevan shehaiqqar kehaomerim shechiyyub birkat hammazon min hattora taluy baakila kede sebia velo bishtiyya:

Vekol zeh keshemmebarekim bezimmun ketiqqun chakamim, shehamzammen lebad hu mebarek umotzi et kullam yede chobatam. Abal akshav shekkullam mebarekim belachash im hamzammen — en lachosh lekol zeh, veyakol lebarek ap mi sheakal kezayit lebad velo shata, ap al pi sheyyesh acherim sheakelu lasoba veshatu. Ella shekkebar nitbaer besiman qp"g sheen linhog ken, ella yishmeu mippi hamzammen lepachot ad siyyum birkat "hazzan":

Mi shehaya kebar sabea qodem sheakal veakal akila gassa, im nehena gerono meotah haakila — mebarek lepanayv uleacharayv, umotzi acherim yede chobatam ap al pi shehem chayyabim min hattora vehu eno chayyab ella middibre soperim. Abal im napsho qatza alayv veen gerono nehena meakilato — eno mebarek kelal, lo lepaneha velo leachareha, lepi shezzo enah chashuba akila kelal lekol mitzvot shebbattora, ben leinyan mitzvot aseh, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"v, ben leinyan mitzvot lo taaseh, kema shekkatabnu besiman try"b:
